name: Dragon's Breath

specialAbility.name: Fire Breath
specialAbility.description: Dragon's Breath unleashes a scorching blast of fire that keeps burning the enemy for 10 damage each turn!

lore: Forged in the heart of a volcano by an ancient dragon, this truck breathes REAL FIRE! Its dark red scales shimmer in the heat, and its exhaust pipes glow white-hot before every attack. Other trucks can feel the heat from across the arena. When Dragon's Breath rolls in, the temperature goes WAY up!
